user_problem: A knowledge collection contains evidence with stated review periods or supersession rules that need orderly attention.
unique_output: A prioritized review queue with item, supplied expiry rule, trigger date, dependent claims, priority basis, and safe interim label.
required_input: Evidence records, dates, review rules, dependent-item links, supersession notes, and priority policy.
critical_rule: Do not declare evidence false after its review date; label it due for review according to supplied policy.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is content-refresh-plan; this queues evidence review across a collection rather than planning updates to one page.
acceptance_scenario: Input E1 dated January 1 has six-month review rule and supports K1; E2 has no review rule; priority favors more dependents. Output queues E1 for July 1, leaves E2 unscheduled, and labels K1 evidence review due.
